bias.en: Bearish, improving · SAR turned bullish, above the 10-day
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · SAR 转多，站上 10 日均线

read.en: SanDisk rose 7.7% on Oct 28 to $1,404.77, trading between $1,343.85 and $1,408.45. It is above the falling 5-day ($1,292.8) and 10-day ($1,327.3) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,250.7), and below the falling 30-day ($1,566.4) and 100-day ($1,614.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($1,228.89), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 闪迪 10月28日上涨 7.7%，收于 $1,404.77，盘中区间 $1,343.85–1,408.45。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,292.8）和 10 日均线（$1,327.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,250.7）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$1,566.4）和 100 日均线（$1,614.6）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$1,228.89），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The rally cleared all three written resistances, $1,316 (Oct 27 high), $1,325–1,327 (Jul 17 low, 10-day) and $1,375 (old SAR), now support. Resistance is $1,407–1,408.5 (Oct 19 and Oct 28 highs), then $1,416.6–1,424.5 (Aug 24 low, Oct 21 high) and $1,500–1,504 (Sep 16 low). Support is $1,343.9 (Oct 28 low), then $1,325–1,327 and $1,287.8–1,300. A close above $1,424.5 would target $1,500; below $1,343, $1,327.
